input_selection: INPUTS.json; exact source raw-log SHA-256 and deterministic selection in freeze_inputs.py
configuration_order: arm-major, then specimen_order; no data-dependent reordering
windows: Reuse all four exact rational shifts and both widths from the selected historical record; no reproposal or adjustment
box_definition: For each axis, center +/- radius_multiplier*original_half_width from INPUTS.json; point means identical endpoints

basis.generator: numpy.linalg.eigh of the 128-bit assembled center midpoint converted to binary64, once per specimen
basis.serialization: Each finite float formatted with .17g, parsed as an exact Fraction, reduced numerator/denominator string, complete 196x196 row-major matrix
basis.retention: Seven matrices plus centers and hashes must be durable before any arm; every arm loads the frozen artifact rather than regenerating
basis.historical_identity: Historical V was not retained; this is a new fixed-basis reconstruction, not historical byte reproduction
basis.reuse: Same exact rational matrix for every box, precision and verification stage; reverse arm is mathematically V[:,195::-1] but implementation MUST permute formed K/Gram, never remultiply with reversed V
basis.gram_requirement: Strictly positive rational lower endpoints of every Gram diagonal-dominance margin, verified afresh at the arm precision

arithmetic.assembly: Rebuild outward affine coefficient enclosures from exact frozen CASE inputs at 128 and 256 bits; never promote old 128-bit bounds
arithmetic.operator: K=V^T H(center) V + dx V^T Hx V + dy V^T Hy V - s V^T V
arithmetic.ordering: Reverse arm permutes both rows and columns of formed K and Gram; compare canonical unpermuted K/Gram interval hashes to original_128 before permutation; never recompute products using reversed V; no adaptive pivoting or 2x2 blocks
arithmetic.factorization: Reviewed unpivoted interval LDL; zero-containing pivot stops only that endpoint
arithmetic.verification_repeat: After all four primary endpoints in each configuration, rebuild from serialized basis, exact CASE inputs and recorded shifts in fresh objects, then rerun all four endpoints at the same precision
arithmetic.repeat_comparison: Require identical exact rational Gram and pivot enclosures, statuses and full-inertia counts in the same locked runtime; exclude timings and float diagnostics
arithmetic.independence_limit: Repeat checks retention/reconstruction consistency using the same interval backend; it is not an independent algorithm

admission: Before a configuration starts reserve 4 primary and 4 verification LDL calls and 4 MiB raw-log headroom; reserve 16 MiB for all basis records plus header/receipt; before each eigensolver call append and fsync EIGEN_STARTED (cap7), before each LDL call append and fsync CALL_STARTED (cap448); interrupted starts consume their respective budgets; no automatic resume; an evidence object exceeding reserved headroom is EXECUTION_ERROR, never silently dropped or labeled resource-cap success
record_contract: Header binds exact protocol and implementation commits, INPUTS/SPEC/source hashes and full redacted runtime provenance. EIGEN_STARTED/EIGEN_FINISHED and complete basis records occur before BASIS_SEALED. All seven complete basis records must precede BASIS_SEALED and any endpoint CALL_STARTED/CALL_FINISHED. All events share contiguous sequence, self-hash and prior-full-line hash. Bind specimen, source record, exact box, basis SHA, shift, precision, permutation, Gram margins, unpermuted K/Gram hashes and all pivots/status to each endpoint. Retain all completed endpoints even for inconclusive configurations.
supervision: One childless worker process group; supervisor times from worker launch including basis preparation and repeats; SIGTERM at 1200s, SIGKILL by 1260s; reap and ESRCH group check before atomic receipt; only incomplete final line may be trimmed; no retry of interrupted work
gram_failure: If any required primary Gram margin is not strictly positive, perform the verification Gram calculation, require repeat consistency, retain all margins, record four skipped endpoint slots in both stages and do no LDL; never count skipped slots as started factorizations
configuration_outcome: FOUR_ENDPOINT_TESTS_PASS only if all four primary and repeat endpoint tests have positive Gram bounds, 196 signed pivots and expected full counts; otherwise NO_FOUR_ENDPOINT_PASS; missing stages are INCOMPLETE
accepted_control_rule: If either accepted control fails FOUR_ENDPOINT_TESTS_PASS in original_128, complete the fixed comparisons within budget but mark CONTROL_MISMATCH_REVIEW_REQUIRED and withhold favorable physical interpretation; do not tune, substitute or retry

terminal_semantics.EXECUTION_ERROR: Any binding, source, arithmetic nonfinite, repeat, record, package or receipt failure, exception, memory limit, unexpected exit or group-reap failure
terminal_semantics.DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE_WATCHDOG: Valid deadline receipt plus valid durable prefix; all pending calls/configurations explicitly listed
terminal_semantics.DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE_RESOURCE_CAP: Verified admission or raw-byte cap stop before full completion without a higher-precedence condition
terminal_semantics.CONTROL_MISMATCH_REVIEW_REQUIRED: All 56 configurations completed and verified but accepted-control rule failed
terminal_semantics.DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE: All 56 configurations completed and verified with original_128 controls passing; other arms may remain inconclusive

coverage_policy: Diagnostic arms never modify the historical partition, accepted count or area. Centrally nested boxes are not dyadic tiling descendants; point and nested passes do not certify parent coverage.
provenance: Pin CASE, assembly, method, verifier and all transitive source bytes; lock exact python-flint wheel and installed/mapped native binaries; retain Python/NumPy versions and BLAS/native-library versions and digests, precision/thread settings, complete exact rational bases and permutations; redact personal paths/hostnames and exclude credentials or unrelated environment variables

output_files.event_content: Header embeds complete redacted provenance and all source bindings; counted eigen-start/finish, seven complete basis records and BASIS_SEALED precede endpoint calls; Gram-check, call-start, call-finish and configuration-finish records bind exact inputs and outputs
output_files.hosted_directory: RESULTS.json, SUPERVISOR_RECEIPT.json, MANIFEST.json and precisely the contiguous EVENTS.ndjson.gz.partNNN files declared by RESULTS with byte counts and SHA-256
output_files.packaging: Canonical log unchanged; gzip mtime=0 after offline replay; fixed 500000-byte parts except the last; materializer verifies all part hashes plus raw size/hash before replay
output_files.membership: Manifest lists every evidence file except itself; unexpected, missing, duplicated or stale files are EXECUTION_ERROR; protocol/source docs live outside the evidence directory
output_files.check_only: Fresh reconstruction reproduces RESULTS, receipt binding, derived summaries, part ordering and hashes byte-for-byte without starting any numerical calls

review_gates.before_implementation: Claude PASS binding the exact protocol commit
review_gates.before_physical_execution: Separate implementation-only commit with synthetic/mutation/supervision controls and an explicit Claude PASS binding that exact implementation and this protocol
review_gates.after_execution: Publish complete bounded evidence and request an independent executed-packet audit; no automatic next run

claim_ceiling: Fixed-specimen endpoint diagnostics only; no new coverage, whole-quadrant, full-domain uniform isolation, cutoff-b/agreement, topology, transport, seams, cutoff convergence, v078 or experimental claim
